caveat: Timeframe alignment is descriptive. A conflict between timeframes is the normal state of a market, not an error, and alignment has not been shown to precede better returns.
narrative: 1w: transition, above range · 1d: range, above range · 4h: range, near range top · 1h: transition, above range · 15m: range. The higher timeframe holds a direction while a lower one consolidates - a pause inside a move rather than a disagreement.
